hooks.name: Documentation synchronization
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, check whether public API or architecture changes need documentation updates.

action.prompt: Before finishing: if this turn changed public API routes or schemas (backend/app/api, backend/app/schemas), module boundaries, data stores, Docker services or environment variables, list which of these need updating and update them: backend/openapi.json (regenerate with scripts/export_openapi.py), docs/api.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database.md, docs/deployment.md, .env.example, and docs/implementation-progress.md (status, files, real test results only). If nothing relevant changed, say so in one line.
